# Refined Mortgage Group

> Plain-English mortgage guidance for Wisconsin homebuyers from Ethan Brooks (Mortgage Advisor & Branch Manager, NMLS #1639987), powered by Fairway Independent Mortgage Corporation (NMLS #2289). Equal Housing Opportunity. This is not a commitment to lend; rates and terms are subject to change.

Refined Mortgage Group helps Wisconsin buyers — especially first-time buyers — understand and navigate the mortgage process without jargon.

## Educational content (/blog and /learn)

- [Blog index](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/): plain-English articles on the mortgage process, loan programs, credit, down payments, and buying a home in Wisconsin.
- [Wisconsin's Real Estate Transfer Fee: Who Pays It?](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/wisconsin-real-estate-transfer-fee.html): Wisconsin charges a real estate transfer fee of $3 per $1,000 of price, and state law puts it on the seller. Here's how it works and why buyers should care.
- [How Much Cash Do You Need at Closing in Wisconsin?](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/cash-to-close-wisconsin.html): Your down payment isn't the whole number. A Wisconsin mortgage advisor breaks down cash to close — closing costs, escrow prepaids, and the seller's tax credit.
- [How Much Can a Seller Pay Toward Closing Costs in Wisconsin?](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/seller-paid-closing-costs-wisconsin.html): Wisconsin sellers can cover part of your closing costs, but your loan type caps how much. Conventional, FHA, VA and USDA limits with a real dollar example.
- [How Long Does It Take to Close on a House in Wisconsin?](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/how-long-to-close-on-a-house-wisconsin.html): A Wisconsin mortgage advisor breaks down the real day-by-day timeline from accepted offer to closing day — and whether you can still close before the holidays.
- [Buying a Home in Wisconsin This Fall: Why Less Competition Works in Your Favor](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/buying-a-home-in-wisconsin-this-fall.html): Fewer buyers, more negotiating room. A Wisconsin mortgage advisor breaks down why fall is an underrated time to buy a home — with a real dollar example.
- [What Credit Score Do You Need to Buy a House in Wisconsin?](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/what-credit-score-do-you-need-wisconsin.html): The minimum credit score to buy a house in Wisconsin is lower than most people think. A Wisconsin mortgage advisor breaks down the real numbers by loan type — and what your score costs you in rate.
- [Condo Financing in Wisconsin: Warrantable vs. Non-Warrantable Explained](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/condo-financing-wisconsin.html): Not every Wisconsin condo qualifies for a standard mortgage. A Wisconsin mortgage advisor explains warrantable vs. non-warrantable condos, why it matters, and what it costs when it doesn't.
- [Jumbo Loans in Wisconsin: When You Need One and How Qualifying Is Different](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/jumbo-loan-wisconsin.html): Cross Wisconsin's $832,750 conforming loan limit and you're in jumbo territory. A Wisconsin mortgage advisor explains what actually changes — credit, down payment, reserves — and what doesn't.
- [FHA 203(k) & Renovation Loans in Wisconsin: Financing a Fixer-Upper](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/fha-203k-renovation-loan-wisconsin.html): Wisconsin is full of good houses that need work. A mortgage advisor explains FHA 203(k) and conventional renovation loans — one loan that covers the purchase and the remodel.
- [Buying a Cabin in Wisconsin: How Second-Home Financing Really Works](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/buying-a-cabin-in-wisconsin.html): A Wisconsin mortgage advisor explains how to finance a cabin or lake house — second-home down payments, rates, property requirements, and the rental gray area.
- [Assumable Mortgages in Wisconsin: Can You Take Over the Seller's Rate?](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/assumable-mortgage-wisconsin.html): Some FHA, VA, and USDA loans let a buyer take over the seller's mortgage — rate and all. How assumptions work in Wisconsin, the equity-gap catch, and the real math.
- [Buying a Duplex in Wisconsin: How House Hacking Works](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/buying-a-duplex-wisconsin.html): How to buy a duplex in Wisconsin with as little as 3.5% down, use the other unit's rent to help you qualify, and cut your real housing cost. A Wisconsin mortgage advisor explains with real numbers.
- [When Should You Lock Your Mortgage Rate?](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/when-to-lock-mortgage-rate-wisconsin.html): When to lock your mortgage rate, how long a rate lock lasts, and what happens if rates drop after you lock. A Wisconsin mortgage advisor explains with real numbers.
- [Earnest Money in Wisconsin: How Much Do You Need — and Can You Get It Back?](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/earnest-money-wisconsin.html): Earnest money in Wisconsin usually runs 1–2% of the purchase price. A Wisconsin mortgage advisor explains who holds it, when you get it back, and how to protect your deposit.
- [Seller-Paid Rate Buydowns in Wisconsin: How a 2-1 Buydown Works](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/seller-paid-rate-buydown-wisconsin.html): A seller-paid rate buydown can lower your mortgage payment for the first year or two of ownership. A Wisconsin mortgage advisor breaks down how a 2-1 buydown actually works.
- [Using Gift Funds for Your Down Payment in Wisconsin](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/gift-funds-down-payment-wisconsin.html): Gift funds can cover part or all of your down payment in Wisconsin — but lenders have strict rules about who can give it and how to document it. Here's what actually qualifies.
- [What Happens When a Home Appraises Below the Offer Price in Wisconsin?](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/appraisal-gap-wisconsin.html): An appraisal gap can derail a Wisconsin home purchase fast. A local mortgage advisor explains why it happens, who pays the difference, and how to protect your offer.
- [What Is a Good Debt-to-Income Ratio to Buy a House in Wisconsin?](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/debt-to-income-ratio-for-a-mortgage-wisconsin.html): How much debt is too much to buy a home? A Wisconsin mortgage advisor explains debt-to-income ratio, what counts, the DTI limits by loan type, and a real dollar example.
- [Wisconsin Property Taxes and Escrow: What Your Monthly Payment Really Includes](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/wisconsin-property-taxes-and-escrow.html): Wisconsin has some of the highest property taxes in the U.S. A local mortgage advisor explains escrow, what property tax adds to your monthly payment, and why it changes.
- [ARM vs. Fixed-Rate Mortgage in Wisconsin: When an ARM Makes Sense](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/arm-vs-fixed-rate-mortgage-wisconsin.html): Adjustable-rate mortgages still carry a bad reputation from 2008, but the loan itself isn't the problem. A Wisconsin mortgage advisor breaks down how ARMs actually work and when one can beat a fixed rate.
- [VA Loans in Wisconsin: Zero-Down Benefits for Veterans](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/va-loans-wisconsin.html): VA loans let eligible Wisconsin veterans and service members buy with $0 down and no PMI. Here's who qualifies, what the funding fee actually costs, and how it compares to FHA and USDA.
- [USDA Rural Development Loans in Wisconsin: Zero Down Explained](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/usda-rural-development-loan-wisconsin.html): More of Wisconsin qualifies as 'USDA rural' than most buyers think — including towns just outside Madison and Milwaukee. Here's how the zero-down USDA loan actually works.
- [What Are Closing Costs in Wisconsin — and Who Pays Them?](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/closing-costs-in-wisconsin.html): Closing costs in Wisconsin typically run 2–5% of the purchase price. A Wisconsin mortgage advisor breaks down what they include, who pays what, and how to lower your cash to close — with a real dollar example.
- [First-Time Home Buyer Mistakes That Cost You the House](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/first-time-home-buyer-mistakes.html): The most common first time home buyer mistakes — skipping pre-approval, financing a car mid-purchase, draining savings — and what each one really costs. From a Wisconsin mortgage advisor.
- [When Is Refinancing Worth It? The Break-Even Math](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/when-is-refinancing-worth-it.html): Refinancing is worth it when your monthly savings outlast your closing costs. A Wisconsin mortgage advisor walks through the break-even math — with a real dollar example.
- [How Are Mortgage Rates Determined? What You Can (and Can't) Control](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/how-are-mortgage-rates-determined.html): Mortgage rates come from two layers: market forces you can't control and personal factors you can. A Wisconsin mortgage advisor breaks down how rates are set — with a real dollar example.
- [Self-Employed? How to Qualify for a Mortgage With 1099 Income](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/self-employed-mortgage-wisconsin.html): Self-employed and want to buy a home in Wisconsin? A mortgage advisor explains how lenders count 1099 and business income, the documents you need, and how to qualify.
- [Should You Buy Mortgage Points? The Break-Even Math](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/should-you-buy-mortgage-points.html): Mortgage points lower your rate for a fee paid upfront — but only pay off if you keep the loan long enough. A Wisconsin advisor walks the break-even math with a real dollar example.
- [How to Get Rid of PMI: When It Makes Sense and How to Drop It](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/how-to-get-rid-of-pmi.html): Private mortgage insurance isn't permanent. A Wisconsin mortgage advisor explains what PMI costs, when it's worth paying, and the exact steps to get rid of PMI on a conventional loan.
- [Buying a Home With Student Loan Debt in Wisconsin](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/buying-a-home-with-student-loan-debt.html): Student loan debt rarely stops you from buying a home. A Wisconsin mortgage advisor explains how lenders count student loans in your DTI — and how to qualify for more.
- [What Documents Do You Need to Get Pre-Approved for a Mortgage?](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/documents-needed-for-mortgage-preapproval.html): The mortgage preapproval documents checklist, explained by a Wisconsin advisor: pay stubs, W-2s, tax returns, and bank statements — plus why lenders want each one.
- [Conventional vs FHA Loan in Wisconsin: Which One Fits You?](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/conventional-vs-fha-loan-wisconsin.html): Conventional vs FHA in Wisconsin: a mortgage advisor breaks down credit scores, down payments, and mortgage insurance — with a real dollar example — so you can pick the right loan.
- [Wisconsin Down Payment Assistance: WHEDA and What Qualifies](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/wisconsin-down-payment-assistance-wheda.html): A Wisconsin mortgage advisor breaks down WHEDA down payment assistance — the Easy Close and Capital Access DPA programs, who qualifies, and what you actually pay back.
- [How Much House Can You Actually Afford in Wisconsin?](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/how-much-house-can-you-afford-in-wisconsin.html): A Wisconsin mortgage advisor breaks down how much house you can really afford — the 28/36 rule, what lenders actually look at, and a real dollar example.
- [Rent vs. Buy: What Waiting Really Costs in Wisconsin](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/rent-vs-buy-cost-of-waiting-wisconsin.html): Should you keep renting or buy now? A Wisconsin mortgage advisor breaks down the real cost of waiting, building equity, and how to know when buying makes sense.
- [How to Beat a Cash Offer in Wisconsin (Even With a Loan)](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/how-to-beat-a-cash-offer-in-wisconsin.html): Losing homes to cash buyers? Financed buyers beat cash offers all the time. A Wisconsin mortgage advisor explains the exact strategies that make sellers say yes.
- [How to Buy Before You Sell (and Avoid a Home Sale Contingency)](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/how-to-avoid-a-home-sale-contingency.html): A home sale contingency can weaken your offer. A Wisconsin mortgage advisor explains how to buy your next home before selling your current one — with less stress.
- [Do You Really Need 20% Down to Buy a House?](https://www.ethanbrooks.mortgage/blog/do-you-really-need-20-percent-down.html): The 20% down rule is the most expensive myth in real estate. A Wisconsin mortgage advisor explains what you actually need to put down — and the cost of waiting.
